source_clock: nominal, corroborated by ../pdm_udp.py; no per-capture clock log
masks: energy >=3x per-frequency temporal 20th percentile; SNR >=1% frame max; local adjacent coherence >=0.4 over 3 frames x 5 bins; common weights proportional to excess SNR
ambiguity: second local maximum >=5 degrees away; floor-subtracted ratio >=0.9
packet_size: inferred independently from exact interleaved frame count / mask length

sweep_detection.fallback: all activity, with explicit sweep_not_confirmed flag

evaluation_exclusions.noise_0st_10m: Błędnie wykonane nagranie — potwierdzone przez użytkownika.
